events.title: Taiwan Stock Market May See Additional Support On Wednesday
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has finished higher in two of three trading days since the end of the two-day losing streak in which it had given up almost 820 points or 1.7 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just beneath the 46,100-point plateau and it's expected to open in the green again on Wednesday.

events.title: Singapore Stock Market May Find Traction On Wednesday
events.description: The Singapore stock market has finished lower in back-to-back sessions, slipping more than 25 points or 0.4 percent in that span. The STI now sits just beneath the 5,400-point plateau although it may stop the bleeding on Wednesday.

events.title: Malaysia Stock Market May Add To Its Winnings On Wednesday
events.description: The Malaysia stock market bounced higher again on Tuesday, one day after it had ended the four-day winning streak in which it had risen almost 15 points or 0.9 percent. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,610-point plateau and it's tipped to open to the upside again on Wednesday.

events.title: Japan Stock Market May Extend Tuesday's Gains
events.description: The Japan stock market on Tuesday wrote a finish to the three-day losing streak in which it had tumbled almost 1,450 points or 2.2 percent. The Nikkei now sits just beneath the 63,270-point plateau and it figures to see additional support on Wednesday.

events.title: Tech Shares Likely To Boost KOSPI On Wednesday
events.description: The South Korea stock market has alternated between positive and negative finishes through the last six trading days since the end of the two-day winning streak in which it had rallied more than 210 points or 3.6 percent. The KOSPI now sits just beneath the 5,640-point plateau and it may add to its winnings on Wednesday.

events.title: New Zealand Interest Rate Decision Due On Wednesday
events.description: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand will on Wednesday wrap up its monetary policy meeting and then announce its decision on interest rates, highlighting a modest day for Asia-Pacific economic activity. The RBNZ is expected to hike its Official Cash Rate (OCR) by 25 basis points, to 3.00 percent from 2.75 percent.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Advances Ahead Of Fed's Rate Decision While Middle East Tensions Continue
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value edged higher on Tuesday as investors are bracing for the interest rate announcement by the U.S. Federal Reserve tomorrow while Middle East concerns persist with a breakthrough in U.S.-Iran peace efforts remaining elusive.

events.title: TSX Rises As Materials Stocks Surge; Celestica Soars On Strong Earnings
events.description: Canada's S&P/TSX Composite Index rose 200.20 points to 36,144.36 Tuesday, driven by materials sector strength. Energy stocks declined as oil prices fell, easing inflation concerns. Celestica surged nearly 13% on upbeat earnings.

events.title: Swiss SMI Closes 0.4% Higher After Mid-Day Volatility
events.description: Switzerland's benchmark SMI index gained 58.68 points to close at 14,597.63 after fluctuating between gains and losses throughout Tuesday's session. VAT Group led gainers with a 3.5% climb, while Galderma Group declined over 3%.

events.title: European Equities Rally On Tech Strength Amid Policy Watch
events.description: European stocks ended Tuesday higher on technology gains tied to artificial intelligence developments, including Nvidia's partnership with Meta. The Stoxx 600 advanced 0.5% as investors watched for upcoming central bank policy decisions.

events.title: U.S. Consumer Confidence Unexpectedly Sees Substantial Improvement In October
events.description: Consumer confidence in the U.S. has unexpectedly seen a substantial improvement in the month of October, according to a report released by the Conference Board on Tuesday. The Conference Board said its consumer confidence index jumped to 91.7 in October from an upwardly revised 84.2 in September.

events.title: U.S. New Home Sales Pull Back Much Less Than Expected In September
events.description: A report released by the Commerce Department on Tuesday showed a modest pullback in new home sales in the U.S. in the month of September. The Commerce Department said new home sales fell by 0.6 percent to an annual rate of 676,000 in September after surging by 5.1 percent to a revised rate of 680,000 in August.

events.title: Boeing Q3 Loss Narrows, Commercial Airplanes Revenues Drop; Shares Down
events.description: Aerospace and defense major Boeing Co. reported Tuesday that its third-quarter net loss narrowed sharply, while it recorded an operating profit, compared to prior year's loss, amid lower expenses and higher revenues. Commercial Airplanes revenue, meanwhile, dropped from last year, despite higher deliveries. In the morning trading on the NYSE, the shares were losing 3.64 percent.
